lines.en: I land and fold my wings.
On all fours I shuffle awkwardly.
My wingtips drag on the ground.
Two steps and I already want to fly.

lines.zh: 我在山脊的石头上找落脚处。
lines.en: I look for footing on the ridge stones.

lines.zh: 我的影子在山坡上滑过。
lines.en: My shadow slides over the slope.

lines.zh: 我从一块岩石跳到下一块。
lines.en: I hop from one rock to the next.

lines.zh: 风一吹，我就张开一侧翅膀。
lines.en: When the wind comes, I open one wing.

lines.zh: 我在冰封的山顶慢慢走。
lines.en: I walk slowly on the frozen summit.
My claws don't grip flat ground well.

lines.zh: 我沿着崖边走，那里风大。
lines.en: I walk the cliff edge where the wind is strong.

lines.zh: 我拍了一下翅膀，卸掉一点重量。
lines.en: One wingbeat sheds some of my weight.

lines.zh: 我在砾石坡上滑了一下。
lines.en: I slip on the gravel slope.
A few steps and I stop.
I tilt my head to measure the drop.
I run up first, then launch.
I stand with my wings folded at my sides.
My crest streams back in the wind.
I'm waiting for a rising current.
I lift my head to see which way the clouds go.

lines.zh: 我的喙很长，几乎碰到胸口。
lines.en: My beak is long, almost reaching my chest.
I open my wings a little to air them.
I hold still on the cliff top.
I shift my weight to my front claws.
The wind carries a taste of ice.
The summit is very quiet.
I count the trees below.
I adjust my stance.
I look at that cloud again.
You're down there like a small dot.
I can see a long way from here.
It took you this long to climb up.

lines.zh: 我不喜欢有人站在我起飞的位置。
lines.en: I don't like anyone standing where I take off.

lines.zh: 我的翼展比你的门还宽。
lines.en: My wingspan is wider than your door.
I can hear you panting.
My beak points ahead, not at you.

lines.zh: 这里风大得能把人吹倒。
lines.en: The wind up here can knock a person over.
I stumble half a step and steady.
Feathers drift down.
I cough, high and sharp.
My wing bones ache.
I edge inland.
This won't keep me from flying.
I shake my crest.
Blood falls on the stone.
I'll get airborne again.
Fish — the kind that comes from water.
That one in your hand is too dry.
I don't eat on the ground.
Hold the fish up so I can see it.
I'm quicker catching fish than taking them.
Try tossing it up.
I need a turn in the air first.
What I eat is still in the water.
You bumped my wing.
I'm pushed back toward the cliff edge.
My wing bones are light, and brittle.
You stepped on my wingtip.
I spread a wing to brace myself.

lines.zh: 风把我们一起推向一边。
lines.en: The wind pushes us both one way.
I slip half a step on the stone.
You've cost me my balance.
We're both in danger now.
I've shifted inland.
Another circles the far cliff.
We wheel in the updraft.
Its crest is longer than mine.
We glided side by side a while.
It dived first; I followed.
Our calls are high and sharp.
We share one cliff wall.
There's a tear in its wing.
When the wind rose, it left.
We never met on the ground.

lines.zh: 我在崖边一捞，鱼还在甩尾。
lines.en: I scoop along the cliff edge and the fish still thrashes.
This is heavier than I am.
I try to fly and can't.

lines.zh: 我把它从石缝里拖出来。
lines.en: I drag it out of the rock crevice.
This fish still smells of the sea.

lines.zh: 我吃了一口，剩下的扔了。
lines.en: I eat a bite and drop the rest.
I can't hold it steady.

lines.zh: 掉下崖的东西我捡不到。
lines.en: What falls off the cliff I can't retrieve.
I'll carry it and find a spot.
Something's moving on the water below.
I spread both wings.
I've adjusted my angle.
The wind is going up just right.

lines.zh: 这一带是我常来的猎场。
lines.en: This is my usual hunting ground.
I've fixed on that shadow.
I'm going down.
One fold of the wings and it begins.
Stand where you are and don't move.
This altitude is perfect.
I see everything from up here.
The wind is helping me now.
You're very visible on open ground.

lines.zh: 我等你的注意力在别处。
lines.en: I wait for your attention to be elsewhere.

lines.zh: 我借着崖壁的上升气流。
lines.en: I ride the updraft along the cliff.

lines.zh: 你抬头的时候，我已经转过去了。
lines.en: By the time you look up, I've wheeled away.
You can't move fast; the wind is faster.

lines.zh: 我数着你还有几步到崖边。
lines.en: I count your steps to the cliff edge.
No hurry; I can stay up indefinitely.

lines.zh: 我看见你了，风会替我追上。
lines.en: I see you. The wind will carry me to you.
My beak tip stabs your shoulder.
My wingtip brushed you.

lines.zh: 这一下带着落地的重量。
lines.en: That carried the weight of my landing.

lines.zh: 我被弹开，扑了两下翅膀。
lines.en: I'm knocked back and beat my wings twice.
My wing sweeps across you.
The impact pushes you back.
I grab and rise straight away.
I didn't get a good grip.

lines.zh: 你再站不稳就要掉下去。
lines.en: Lose your footing again and you'll fall.
My claws are thin, and sharp.
I land back on the cliff and fold my wings.
I open my wings on the ridge.
The wind lifts me.
It's high here; I'm used to it.
I've landed on the cliff top.
First I scan the valley.
Cold air surges up from below.
My shadow lands on the gravel.

lines.zh: 我的翼展在石头上展开。
lines.en: My wingspan spills across the rock.
These peaks are mine to patrol.

lines.zh: 我把喙在石头上敲了敲。
lines.en: I tap my beak on the stone.
There's water glinting far off.

lines.zh: 我轻轻一蹬，就悬起来了。
lines.en: One push and I'm airborne.

lines.zh: 我找了一处背风的岩台。
lines.en: I find a rock ledge out of the wind.
The warm air below is rising.

lines.zh: 热风把它推上来，我逃向高处。
lines.en: The heat shoves air upward and I climb away.

lines.zh: 我收翅不及，撞在崖壁上。
lines.en: I couldn't fold in time and hit the cliff.

lines.zh: 我落进水里，翅膀立刻沉了。
lines.en: I hit the water and my wings drag me down.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿过了我的翼膜。
lines.en: An arrow tears through my wing membrane.

lines.zh: 一道光锁住我，我掉了下去。
lines.en: Light locks me and I drop.

lines.zh: 水面上没有鱼，我越来越轻。
lines.en: No fish on the water, and I grow lighter.

lines.zh: 雷在云里炸开，我被震得歪了。
lines.en: Lightning cracks in the cloud and I veer off.

lines.zh: 这里没有空气可以托住我。
lines.en: There's no air here to hold me.
